# Style Guide

> The owner's coding, documentation and writing style as rules with evidence, plus skills to write in it, review against it and keep it current.

## Start Here

- [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md): working rules, rule format, precedence
- [`README.md`](README.md): layout, skills, install

## Rules

- [`common/principles/README.md`](common/principles/README.md): rules across languages
- [`common/languages/README.md`](common/languages/README.md): deltas per language
- [`common/writing/README.md`](common/writing/README.md): README, runbook, prose, commit, PR, email
- [`common/digest/README.md`](common/digest/README.md): which digest to read per artifact
- [`common/digest/core.md`](common/digest/core.md): the core rules, read for every task
- [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md): rule changes
- [`common/retired.txt`](common/retired.txt): retired rule IDs, never reused
- [`scripts/`](scripts/): rule checker, digest builder, `scripts/install.sh` (installs the skills)
- [`common/evidence/README.md`](common/evidence/README.md): method, weighting and the skill evaluation
- [`common/evidence/sources.md`](common/evidence/sources.md): which material backs which rules
- [`OPEN-QUESTIONS.md`](OPEN-QUESTIONS.md): undecided points

## Skills

- [`style-write`](common/skills/style-write/SKILL.md): write in the style
- [`style-review`](common/skills/style-review/SKILL.md): review against the style
- [`style-update`](common/skills/style-update/SKILL.md): change the rules with the owner's approval
- [`style-audit`](common/skills/style-audit/SKILL.md): audit the guide
